description: Needs a SpaceNexus API key with SpaceNexus Research. Search parsed SEC Form 4 and Form 5 insider transactions (with open-market codes P and S kept separate from grants and withholding) and Schedule 13D/G 5%-holder filings for US-listed space companies. Disclosure reporting only.

include_positions.description: Also return Schedule 13D/G 5%-holder rows for the same window.

limit.description: How many rows to return per table (1 to 25).

offset.description: Transaction rows to skip, for paging (0 to 10000).

open_market_only.description: Only return open-market purchases and sales (Form 4 codes P and S).

name: insider_activity_search
title: SEC insider activity search
